newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Helix leads Gawler Craton shares up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Helix leads Gawler Craton shares up.

text.p: Shares in gold explorers with interests in the much-touted Gawler Craton area in South Australia shot ahead again on Monday as traders punted on forthcoming announcements.

Helix Resources NL shares led the way higher, surging 80 cents to A$4.20 by 3.45 p.m. (0450 GMT) on turnover of 1.8 million shares. Another explorer with interests in the region to see strong gains was Grenfell Resources NL, up seven cents to 72 cents on volume of 1.67 million shares, while Equinox Resources NL added over 10 cents to 94 cents on tunover of 1.2 million shares.
Pima Mining NL shares jumped nine cents to 66 cents on volume of 512,328 shares,while Minotaur Gold NL shares climbed over eight percent to 76 cents on turnover of 260,550 shares.
"Helix have been given a run on the hope that they have some decent results to release again," said a Perth-based dealer, adding that others in the area had trailed Helix higher.
"All the Gawler stocks have run on the back of it."
Quarterly reports for the December quarter are due to be released to the Australian Stocks Exchange by January 31.

Explorers with interests in the highly prospective South Australian region have been star performers in the Australian market since Helix reported promising drilling results on November 18, 1996 from its Lake Everard project in the region.

Helix shares have been the most spectacular performers among the companies in the region, rocketing from 45 cents on November 15, 1996 to a high of A$4.15, heights its shares scaled on November 28, 1996 and again today.
